butyrate and related histone deacety-lase inhibitors induce apoptosis in human colon cancer cell lines and that the induction of apoptosis is correlated with histone hyperacetylation.

butyrate, an inhibitor of histones deacetylase that has been proposed as an antineoplastic agent, induces apoptosis in some colon cancer cells and that the potency of this induction correlates with the potency of butyrate to induce hyperacetylation.

butyrate and structurally dissimilar inhibitors of histone deacytlase induce chromatin fragmentation (apoptosis) in adenocarcionna cell lines and that the potency of the histone deacytase inhibitors correlates with the degree of hyperacetylation.

the molecular mechanisms of action of histone acetylases and deacetylases and their role in cell cycle regulation, differentiation, and apoptosis.

the molecular mechanisms of butyrate-induced cell death in cancer cells.
